Name: The Living Valley
Author: mariachaan
TagLine: What if Pelican Town felt a little more alive every day?
Description:
The Living Valley keeps the cozy vanilla feeling but adds a living world layer. Villagers react more naturally, requests change over time, market prices move with town activity, and the newspaper reflects what is happening around you.

Requirements:

Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0+
Player2 connection (FREE using the gpt-oss-120b AI model)

Installation:

Option 1: Easy Setup (Recommended) – Player2 App

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download this mod.
3. Extract StardewLivingRPG into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Download and install the Player2 app.
5. Open the Player2 app and make sure it’s running and you are logged in.
6. Select gpt-oss-120b in the AI model selection if you want to play for free, which is good enough for the newspaper and market trends. But for better narrative and context flow, I recommend Gemini 3 Flash or DeepSeek V3.2
7. Launch the game through SMAPI.
8. Load your save and play.

Option 2: Manual Connection – Browser Website

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download this mod.
3. Extract StardewLivingRPG into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
5. Load your save and play.
6. If prompted, connect Player2 in-game (open browser and enter code).
7. Once the code is approved, go back in-game and wait for authorization.


First-Time Quick Start:

Press K to open the Market Board.
Press J to read today's newspaper.
Press L to check town requests.
Talk to villagers and choose the follow-up chat option after vanilla dialogue.

OtherFields.patchNotes:
- New Living Valley menu: open the Market, Newspaper, Requests, Farmhands, AI Provider and Settings from one button. No hotkeys needed, so it works on mobile and with a controller.
- New in-game Settings menu. Generic Mod Config Menu is now optional and will be dropped in a later update.
- Choose your AI: Player2 (default), OpenRouter with your own key, or a local LLM such as LM Studio or Ollama.
- New options: turn the daily newspaper off, add your own note to the AI, move the Valley button to any corner.
- Villagers know their own birthdays and gender from game data, including Content Patcher edits and modded NPCs.
- Buttons across every Living Valley menu got a beveled look closer to vanilla Stardew.
- Fixed villagers and farmhands walking through walls after face-to-face chats and at the end of shifts.
- Fixed villagers going silent when the Player2 app gets stuck; the mod now reconnects on its own.
- Fixed "User Safety: safe" replies on OpenRouter, stray symbols and names in speech bubbles, and broken newspaper headlines.
- Fixed Korean words running together in the mod's menus when a Korean translation is installed.
